Name: Recycle Joja Cola
Author: Jibblestein
Description:
I've implemented the same rules as XxHarvzBackxX's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10865?tab=description]Recyclable Cola[/url] using CP so it works with Automate.

With this mod, Recycling Machines will accept Joja Cola and produce 1-3 iron ore.
